name: Griffith Tax Clinic
summary: Free tax help from supervised Griffith student advisers, including tax returns and ATO notices.
how: Apply through the online form, email taxclinic@griffith.edu.au or call +61 7 338 21177.
catches: Runs at Logan campus (L08, Room 1.11) on Tuesdays, plus Wednesdays in Trimester 2, 9am to 4pm.

evidence.quote: Providing free tax assistance to help you navigate Australia's complex tax system.
